case.title: Contributor shares a different phone, but the target's own device is single-user

submissions.open_text: Our own connection was installed last year and bills are manageable.
Borehole water tastes salty so we boil it before drinking.
Water seller comes twice a week and the containers look dirty.
Flooding last month washed latrine waste into the river where we collect water.

case.why: The check is keyed on device_id, not on the contributor. dev-k9 is genuinely shared (E01 via u and E02 via v), so u and v would fire. The target t, however, is on dev-k1, which only E01 has used (t and w): 1 distinct contributor. A wrong implementation that flags every submission of a contributor who has ever touched a shared device would fire on t. So would one that unions all devices per contributor. The other checks stay quiet for t: it is E01's only submission on 2024-05-13, its point is inside Kondele, it is a daytime interview of 1500 s, and its transcript is empty.
